points_of_interest.name: Waterloo forest
points_of_interest.description: State Monument Waterloopbos is a historic open-air laboratory in a beautiful polder forest. Here hundreds of studies have been carried out into the behavior of water. You will find remnants of the research for the Delta Works, but also water works for exotic places such as the port of Lagos.

points_of_interest.name: Former harbour Schokland
points_of_interest.description:
Wooden platforms and moorings of the reconstructed harbour on the former island of Schokland, Unesco world heritage in the Netherlands

Photocredits: Ernst Dirksen Fotografie

points_of_interest.name: Museum Schokland
points_of_interest.description:
Geological, archaeological and historical objects in the permanent exhibition give a picture of the genesis of the Noordoostpolder area, the origin and disappearance of the island, the life of the Schokker population and the eventual reclamation of the polder.

Photocredits: Museum Schokland
